parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.description:
The feedback type. Valid values:

- good: like
- bad: dislike.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the chatbot.

parameters.name: MessageId
parameters.description: The ID of the response message in the conversation.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID, which identifies a visitor's session and maintains context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to pass this field when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId in the response of the Chat operation. For subsequent conversation turns of the same visitor, pass the current SessionId when calling the Chat operation so that the chatbot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId.
